title: Dynamics 365 Sales: copy a Sales Development agent's configuration to another agent
summary: Hold: the briefing implies that source access rules protect knowledge re-added to an agent, but Microsoft warns that shared content can reach people without its original permissions. It also reports activation automation as undocumented despite a documented beta activation API, and overstates activation as the only relevant administrative control.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All Agents > Sales Development (Frontier) > Activate leads to configuring which users or groups can create instances.
claims.quote:
In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Agents > All Agents.
Search for Sales Development (Frontier), and then select Activate.
Choose the users or groups that can create Sales Development agent instances.
claims.fix: Keep the path, which reaches the activation procedure, and append to controls[1].note: 'After selecting Activate, choose the users or groups that can create instances and apply a policy template that allows agent instance creation.' The cited activation page gives these remaining steps.

claims.where: controls[1].api
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented automation for choosing the users or groups allowed to create Sales Development agent instances.
claims.quote:
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/activate
agentManagerScope | Required. The users or groups allowed to create instances from this template.
claims.fix: Set controls[1].api to kind 'graph', call 'POST /beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/activate', and docs to https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/package/copilotpackageactivationresult-activate. Add to its note: 'The beta request sets agentManagerScope to choose who can create instances and requires policyTemplateId. This is a reviewed beta contract: availability depends on the matching schema and backend release, and API-review approval is not evidence of deployed availability. Package Management API access requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence.'

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure, second bullet
claims.claim: Existing access rules for knowledge sources apply when those sources are added separately to the target agent.
claims.quote: The content you share with an agent, such as files, chat history, or emails, might be summarized or included in the agent's responses to other users, even those individuals who don't originally have access to that content.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: Activation is the only documented administrative control that touches this feature.
claims.quote:
Copilot Frontier is enabled in the Microsoft 365 admin center: Copilot > Settings > Copilot Frontier.
All users who create agent instances are enabled for Frontier features. As an administrator, you can still control which Frontier agents users can access.
claims.fix: Replace 'The only documented admin control that touches this feature is activation of the Sales Development agent, which decides which users or groups can create agent instances' with 'Activation of the Sales Development agent decides which users or groups can create agent instances'. Keep the following sentence distinguishing instance creation from configuration export and import.
